mira_briarfield.say: I've been in this town an hour. The irrigation Node won't open for me. Mara says it only responds to 'someone with a proper Debugger'.
I'd say I'm offended, but I'm mostly curious. So. Another round. For science!

win.say: Your Bytekin trust you. Mine trust me... conditionally.
Okay. The Node's yours. I'm going to the library to find out why my notes keep changing.

nurse_heal.say: Welcome to the Briarfield Patch Center! We repair, recharge, and gently reboot Bytekin.

nurse_heal.ask: Shall I patch up your whole party?

yes.say: All done! Your Bytekin are in perfect condition. Not too perfect, I hope.

no.say: Come back any time. I'm very stable. It's a job requirement.

hub_clerk.say: Welcome to BRIARFIELD HUB. We sell what you need and a few things you don't.

mart_clerk.say: Welcome to RIVERMOOR MART! Everything is exactly where it was. Mostly.
Thank you! The vending machine's out front, if you like free drinks.

mart_clerk_after.say: Welcome to RIVERMOOR MART! Please ignore the shelves that are a little less shelf-like than they were.
Please come again. If 'again' is still a thing.

node1_enter.say: You're the one with the Debugger. Good. I've been waiting for someone who doesn't poke things with a stick.
I'm MARA. Keeper of Node 1. Briarfield's irrigation runs through here. Lately the channels have been running *uphill*. And the crops have been showing up twice.
Three channels carry the water: LEFT, MIDDLE, RIGHT. Three valves control them. Get all three flowing at once and the Control Room opens.
My apprentices are in the way. Battle them if they see you. I trained them to stop trespassers.
Notes are on the wall. Read them. Everything on that wall is true, which is more than I can say about the pipes.

then.say: The Control Room is open. Go on. I'll meet you there.

else.say: Stuck? The notes on the wall tell you what each valve does. V1 flips LEFT and MIDDLE. V2 flips MIDDLE and RIGHT. V3 flips RIGHT only.
A flowing channel is blocked. A dry channel is walkable. You need all three flowing - and you start with all three dry.

else.ask: Want the answer? ...I'll tell you if you ask nicely.

yes.say: The outer valves. V1 and V3. Leave the middle one alone.

no.say: Good. Figuring it out is half the Node.

mara_boss.say: My Bytekin share a CACHE LINK. They back each other up every other turn. Not a trick. Just good housekeeping.
Break the LINK and they stop recovering. Hit hard, and don't be shy about their Stability. Let's see what you've got!

win.say: The channels run clean. You earned this.
That's ROOT KEY 01. Proof that Node 1 is restored. It also unlocks something for your Debugger.
PULSE. Your Debugger can now send a pulse into dormant Signal switches. They're all over Velora. Most of them lead somewhere interesting.
Funny thing. The water ran clean the instant you opened the valves. Too clean. I don't like clean.
Go outside. Look at the town. Tell me I'm wrong.

mara_after.say: Look after that Root Key. It's more than a trophy.

yes.say: There. Good as new. Or good as slightly-older.

voss_meeting.say: I'm Silas Voss. Director of Clean State. I came personally. It isn't every day an irrigation fault of this scale resolves itself.
We had been tracking it for months. It turns out one of our own relays was the cause. You fixed in an afternoon what my engineers could not in a season.
May I see it? The Debugger. I promise to be gentle.

yes.say: Remarkable. A Mark IV, if I'm not mistaken. I helped design the first.
You keep it. It seems to like you. Most things do, I suspect, for the first few minutes.

no.say: Wise. It's a delicate thing. I would have asked the same.

voss_meeting.say: Tell Ellis I said hello. He'll know who.
We have placed a checkpoint on the south road to Whisperwood while we recalibrate the region's Signal. Registered Debuggers may pass. You are registered. Do try to be seen.
You see, every tragedy begins as an exception.
NO ERRORS. NO UNCERTAINTY. It isn't a slogan. It's a promise. Good afternoon.
{p}? ...Was there a man in a white coat? Grey hair. Careful voice.
Did he give his name? ...No. Never mind. Don't tell me.
Don't give him the Debugger. Please. I'll explain when I can. I just... need a little more time.
The road south is open to you, registered Debugger. Whisperwood, then Bellwether City. And everything you skipped here is still waiting. The Signal keeps humming.

cs_worker1.say: Clean State field team. We're calibrating the irrigation sensors. Please stay off the pipes.
Sir - ma'am - citizen - please do not duplicate the crops. They're already within tolerance.

cs_worker2.say: This town used to be 4% noisy. Now it's 0.2%. We're extremely proud.

cs_worker3.say: Debugger registered. You may pass. NO ERRORS. NO UNCERTAINTY.
...Do you want to try the slogan? Everyone says it feels nice.

kid_savelet_start.say: My imaginary friend disappeared. His name's SAVELET. He lived near the little computer machines.
Mom says imaginary friends can't 'disappear' because they were never there. But I saw him. He had a blue body. He waved.

kid_savelet_start.ask: Will you look for him? You have the scanner thing.

yes.say: Thank you! He only came out near the terminals. Try the one in Briarfield. It's the one nearest the pipes.

no.say: It's okay. He'll find his own way back. I hope.

kid_savelet_wait.say: Did you find SAVELET? He only shows up near terminals. Use your scanner thing!

kid_savelet_found.say: You... found him?! He's - he's with you?
He says you almost lost to him twice. He remembers *everything*.
He wants to stay with you. He says you're the first person who ever left him a save point.

kid_savelet_done.say: SAVELET says hello. Mostly in typing noises.

savelet_scan.say: Behind the terminal, a small blue shape darts between pixels. It looks very, very tired.

crops_start.say: Our crops have been doubling up overnight. I don't mind the extra, but the *extra* has opinions.
Could you look for the originals - I mean, the duplicates? There's three, I think. Use your Field Scan. Walk close to a glittering crop and press A.

then.say: That's a Contain Module for each pair of hands. Don't ask where I got them. The Hub sells them. I mean. I didn't get them.

else.say: Use your Field Scan: walk near a glittering spot in the fields and press A. You've found {crops_found} so far.

briar_arrive.text: Briarfield - the Hub heals and sells supplies.

barn_pulse.say: Somewhere behind the hay, a heavy bolt slides back. The old gate swings open!
